description: One malformed edge, one abstract kind — regardless of whether the mantle happens to contain a box. An edge naming an endpoint that is not a rune of the mantle is `adapter-ports` through the flat adapter, and this case asserts it stays `adapter-ports` through the composing one: the mantle here holds a box (`p1`), so the composition path runs, and the offending edge names `ghost`, which is no rune at all. Before this case the composing path answered `box-interface` for it, so the same defect in the same document reported two different kinds depending only on whether some OTHER rune was a box — the one thing a conformance runner exists to prevent, and it was reachable because no case covered it. Found by Void Unity, 2026-08-29, by porting the runner rather than reading it.
